subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: After requester wake succeeds but required message-tool delivery has no valid evidence, should the completion become terminally failed or remain retryable for visible delivery?
rationale: The PR intentionally clears pending delivery and completes cleanup, while a retry-preserving design would retain delivery ownership; this orchestration policy cannot be inferred safely from tests or existing source.

options.title: Terminal visible failure
options.body: Credit requester wake, persist visible delivery as failed, fail linked task delivery, clear the pending payload, and stop retries.

options.title: Preserve visible retries
options.body: Credit requester wake separately but retain required visible delivery as pending until evidence appears or existing retry limits suspend it.

recommendation.title: Terminal visible failure
recommendation.body: Credit requester wake, persist visible delivery as failed, fail linked task delivery, clear the pending payload, and stop retries.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent current-main work owns the persisted registry and native-subagent completion lifecycle most directly affected by this choice.
